$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F01 GCD detail (A6): the right temple at the hinge, close, from the front right. The engraved wordmark and old emblem come off stroke by stroke. The GCD is placed with tools/photo/temple_gcd.py: the temple's edges are nearly parallel in this view, so the old print's proportions give how much the temple is foreshortened along its length.

lenses.name: far lens (wearer's left), cut by the edge

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges, which the stroke detector would otherwise take for strokes)
